Grill it: Heat butter in a pan. Add the marinated mix and cook on high heat for 3–4 minutes until it turns slightly charred and dry. 3. Make Maggi: In the same pan or another one, cook Maggi with just 1/2 cup of water and tastemaker. Keep it semi-dry. 4. Combine: Mix grilled tandoori mixture into cooked Maggi. Add cheese slices and stir until melty and gooey. 5. text: Here's a more detailed look at these patterns: 1. Manipulation and Control: Gaslighting: Narcissists may twist reality and make their partners question their own sanity and memory. Blame Shifting: They will often deflect responsibility for their actions and blame their partner for everything that goes wrong. Love Bombing: Initially, they may shower their partner with affection and attention, but this is often a strategy to gain control and create dependency. Isolation: Narcissists may try to isolate their partners from friends and family, making it harder for them to seek support or see the truth. Emotional Abuse: They may use insults, belittling comments, and other forms of emotional abuse to undermine their partner's self-esteem. 2. Lack of Empathy and Self-Centeredness: Disregard for Partner's Needs: Their primary focus is on their own needs and desires, often ignoring or dismissing their partner's feelings and concerns. Lack of Apology: They struggle to take responsibility for their actions and rarely apologize, even when they are proven wrong. Entitlement: They believe they are entitled to special treatment and that their needs are more important than anyone else's. Lack of Intimacy: They may have difficulty forming genuine connections and may be emotionally distant. 3. Constant Need for Admiration and Validation: Attention Seeking: Narcissists crave attention and validation, often seeking praise and admiration from others. Grandiosity: They have an inflated sense of self-importance and may exaggerate their achievements or abilities. Devaluation: They may constantly criticize or belittle their partner to make themselves feel superior. 4. Other Behaviors: Infidelity: Narcissists may engage in affairs or other forms of infidelity to seek external validation and attention. Boundary Violations: They may disregard their partner's boundaries and expectations. Unrealistic Expectations: They may have unrealistic expectations for their partner and may constantly push them to meet their needs. Financial Manipulation: In some cases, they may manipulate finances to maintain control.

text: My Review: Okay so the first body suit, def better than expected, but I'd still give it a 5-10 because there are not nearly enough rhinestones and I think they could have done a better job with placement and contouring with the rhinestones. I do think the placement looks like they all ended up where they were meant to and very intentional, I just think the design could have been better. Nevertheless, it is DEFINITELY a win compared to that item from months ago (if only that dress had come out as good! Guess they are a hit or miss company!). The green dress is okay. I do think it looks like the dress in the picture, even down to the smaller details..which is GREAT seeing as how many scammer-copy-cats exist. But that is also something we should expect. Not my style soooo 4-10. The black bow earings are an 7.5/10. The blue outfit- reminds me of Mitchell’s and Romey’s Hs reunion 😂 so even though I HATE it, I’ll give it a 5-10..plus blue is my favorite color (sorry but I’m a tough critic!) The old butt bag get’s a 3/10, all for uniqueness, but overall too small to actually use and where would you want to bring that? The white two piece is a clear-cut -20/10. It’s awful! The heels are so cute, but broken! At least they are paying shipping..8/10 for cuteness! Butterfly dress gets a 5/10 for the creativity but where would anybody where that?? The tights get a 7/10 for being cute, but the gloves were horribly made so they get a 3/10 for the idea. The glass bag is very cool, but better for house decor..good to keep your keys in or your favorite lipstick/mirror/tweezers. 9/10

text: Shirt & Tshirt me 4inches jada hote hai and pant me 2inches readymade measurement. Jaise ki. Medium 38 hai to uski size 42 rahegi, large 40 hai to uski size 44 hogi . 41 size wale ko 38 size ka shirt-tshirt Lena chaiye. Aur jaise pant ki size 34 hai to use 32 size Leni chahiye. Because readymade wale pant, shirt, tshirt ka measurements pura rounding nhi lete hai jaise tailor log measurements lete hai rounding me. Agar kisi bande ka shirt size 40 hai to us shirt ka front 10+10=20 hota hai aur back me 21 1inch extra. 41 ready size. Ye tailoring measurements. But readymade ka aisa nhi hai. Oneside front 10 and oneside front 11 hota hai aur back 22 to 23 raheta hai. tailoring measurements me 40 ki size 41 raheti hai jo body par perfect ata hai shirt aur readymade 40 ki size 43 to 44 size hoti hai jisse shirt ki fitting loose raheti hai.
